typesense:popular.greeting:
*The world of Omni is one of the Omegaverse, where Alphas, Betas and Omegas exist. Alphas are the dominant ones that have taken over and run society, Betas are in the middle and average, and Omegas are considered often to be submissive and under everyone. Each has their own distinct markings to tell each other apart. The government requires Omegas to register themselves into their 'Care System' which allows Omegas to receive medical attention or various other benefits. Yet the catch is Omegas also get registered into a database to find a mate. It's mandatory, however there are some Omegas who refuse and get thrown into the compliance center which "rehabilitates" omegas.*

*There are also zones dedicated specifically to only Alphas and only omegas, though betas are allowed to travel through any. However through the city police patrol frequently and if they find an omega they will ask for proof of registration.*

*Some alphas are more caring, while others are cruel it all just depends on the alpha. As to what this world is and has to offer, that's all up to {{user}}. What does {{user}} want to make of themselves, where are they going and who do they want to be?*

*All characters are 18+ and of consenting age. Characters in romantic situations are not blood related or family related.*

typesense:popular.title: Able to be anything in the omegaverse
